about: Shipped advisories ecodex accepts until upstream codex moves the dependency (scripts/scoped_cargo_audit.py). Each needs a semver-major bump in an upstream crate; re-check at every upstream sync and remove an entry once the audit no longer reports it (a stale entry fails the gate).

accepted.reason: Timing variability in constant-time operations. Fixed in crypto-bigint >=0.7.6; ecodex has 0.5.5 through elliptic-curve 0.13 and p256/p384 (aws-config, age, codex-user-verification, hpke, rtc-dtls), a RustCrypto stack upstream codex has not moved.
Data from an abandoned stream leaks into the next on a reused context. Fixed in zstd >=0.14.3; ecodex has 0.13.3 through upstream's codex-app-server-protocol.
Uninitialized memory exposed when streaming decompression of a legacy frame fails. Fixed in zstd-safe >=8.2.0, which needs zstd 0.14; ecodex has 7.2.4 through zstd 0.13.3.
Seekable::decompress sets a Vec length beyond its capacity for offsets past the end. Fixed in zstd-safe >=8.2.0, which needs zstd 0.14; ecodex has 7.2.4 through zstd 0.13.3.
The WebAssembly allocator shim corrupts memory on allocation failure; ecodex builds no WebAssembly target. Fixed in zstd-sys >=2.1.2, pinned by zstd-safe 7.2.4; ecodex has 2.0.16.
